name: Dental and Oral Examination
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/dental_and_oral_examination.json with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original is a dental care pathway started by a dental referral that every wellness encounter sets: 91% of patients had dental caries, 93% gingivitis, and 96% to 99% a dental referral or fluoride treatment, with United States rates and payment rules. The providers here are public only and do not provide dental care. The only other module that reads its output is dentures, which starts only when the attribute missing_teeth (set here) is 2 or more, so it stays idle; the attribute dental_referral is set by other modules and read only here.
